# Wedding Rehearsal Dinner Etiquette: The Dos and Don’ts

 2024-01-29

![Image 5: Wedding Rehearsal Dinner Etiquette: The Dos and Don’ts](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/public/assets/images/web-article/image/20240129/20240129143440_44589.jpg)

_Source:_ _[Unsplash](https://unsplash.com/photos/clear-wine-glasses-on-table-ADNerVP2LjI)_

In the time leading up to the big day, wedding planning can become both thrilling and frantic. Amidst the flurry of decisions, there is one important event that is often overlooked: the rehearsal dinner.

It is this pre-wedding gathering that sets the tone for the upcoming nuptials and provides an opportunity for the couple, their families, and close friends to come together in a more relaxed setting. To ensure a smooth and enjoyable experience, here’s a quick guide to the dos and don’ts of a wedding rehearsal dinner.

![Image 6: Wedding Rehearsal Dinner Etiquette: The Dos and Don’ts](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/public/assets/images/web-article/image/20240129/20240129143621_92897.jpg)

_Source:_ _[Unsplash](https://unsplash.com/photos/clear-wine-glass-lot-on-table-O38Id\_cyV4M)_

### The Do’s

#### 1. Send Invitations in a Timely Manner

Kick off the rehearsal dinner festivities on a high note by sending out invitations well in advance. This thoughtful gesture gives family members, the wedding party, and close friends plenty of time to organise their attendance. Consider using digital invites to make things even more convenient and efficient.

#### 2. Choose a Comfortable Venue

Take a moment to carefully choose a setting that complements the overall wedding ambience while creating a relaxed and comfortable atmosphere. Whether you fancy a beloved local restaurant, a cosy garden get-together, or the elegance of a charming banquet hall, it’s key to factor in the size of your guest list. This ensures that your chosen venue sets the perfect stage for an intimate celebration.

#### 3. Personalise the Event

Elevate the experience by infusing personalised touches that mirror the couple’s unique personality. Weave in elements like lively photo slideshows highlighting cherished moments, heartwarming decorations, or a menu filled with the couple’s favourite dishes. This not only adds an extra dose of special charm but also ensures the event lingers in the hearts and minds of your guests.

#### 4. Express Gratitude

Take a heartfelt moment during the dinner to express sincere gratitude to those who’ve played crucial roles in bringing our dream wedding to life. Extend warm thanks to the wedding party, supportive family members, and any vendors whose contributions have made this celebration possible. This gesture fosters a sense of appreciation and strengthens the camaraderie among everyone involved.

#### 5. Plan a Brief Rehearsal

Keep the rehearsal itself focused and concise. Provide clear and organised instructions for the wedding ceremony, ensuring everyone knows their respective roles. Save the nitty-gritty discussions and details for the big day to maintain a relaxed atmosphere during the rehearsal dinner.

#### 6. Encourage Mingling

Foster a warm and inviting atmosphere by actively encouraging guests to mingle and get to know one another. This not only helps create a more comfortable environment for the wedding day but also strengthens the sense of community among attendees. Spice things up by incorporating ice-breaker activities to facilitate interactions.

#### 7. Prepare Toasts

If you have vendors present at the rehearsal dinner, ensure that gratuity is prepared in advance. Don’t leave this important detail for the last minute.

![Image 7: Wedding Rehearsal Dinner Etiquette: The Dos and Don’ts](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/public/assets/images/web-article/image/20240129/20240129143931_49217.jpg)

_Source:_ _[Pexels](https://www.pexels.com/photo/white-receipt-on-table-612790/)_

### The Don’ts

#### 1. Overwhelm with Details

While it’s important to go over the key wedding ceremony logistics, avoid bombarding your attendees with an excess of intricate details during the rehearsal dinner. Save the in-depth discussions for the big day, ensuring the rehearsal remains laser-focused on essential information without getting too overwhelming for everyone involved.

#### 2. Exclude Significant Others

Prioritise inclusivity by extending invitations to the significant others of the wedding party whenever you can. Creating a welcoming atmosphere not only fosters a stronger sense of community but adds an extra layer of fun for everyone at the event.

#### 3. Overschedule

Design a schedule that allows for flexibility and breathing room. Steer clear of cramming the evening with too many activities or never-ending speeches, as this can lead to attendee fatigue and diminish the overall enjoyment of the event. Find that sweet spot between structure and spontaneity to create a laid-back and lively atmosphere.

#### 4. Leave Thank You Notes for the Wedding Day

Seize the opportunity during the rehearsal dinner to express genuine gratitude to those who have been part of the wedding preparations. Avoid deferring this meaningful gesture solely to the wedding day, as the rehearsal dinner provides an intimate setting for heartfelt appreciation, setting a positive tone for the entire celebration.

#### 5. Neglect Special Dietary Requirements

Demonstrate thoughtfulness by ensuring that the chosen venue accommodates any dietary restrictions or preferences your guests may have. Take the lead in making sure everyone can fully enjoy the meal, creating an atmosphere of inclusivity and showcasing attentiveness to individual needs.

#### 6. Stress Over Perfection

While attention to detail is important, keep in mind that the rehearsal dinner is intended to be a more relaxed affair. Don’t let the little details overwhelm you—rather, channel your energy into creating a cosy and inviting environment.

#### 7. Delay Gratuity for Vendors

Prioritise professionalism by ensuring that gratuity for vendors present at the rehearsal dinner is prepared in advance. Avoid leaving this crucial detail for the last minute, as timely acknowledgement and compensation contribute to a positive working relationship with vendors and uphold the overall smooth execution of the event.

![Image 8: Wedding Rehearsal Dinner Etiquette: The Dos and Don’ts](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/public/assets/images/web-article/image/20240129/20240129143949_79298.jpg)

_Source:_ _[Pexels](https://www.pexels.com/photo/assorted-flowers-on-table-2253831/)_

### A Prelude to the Big Day

As the prelude to the grand wedding day, the rehearsal dinner is a time for joy, celebration, and connection. By following these dos and don’ts, couples can create a memorable and blissfully stress-free experience for themselves and their loved ones, setting the stage for a beautiful wedding celebration.

Here at Blissful Brides, we want to help you remember your wedding day even years later. With the help of our vendors, you can recall every significant moment of your wedding, from the preparation process to the exchange of rings. To ensure that you have different options to choose from, our vendors offer a range of services for every couple. To capture all the best moments of this special day, as well as depending on your budget, you can hire any of the photographers to either shoot your pre wedding photos or on the actual wedding day, or on both days.

If you are looking to have a nice scenic background in your pre wedding photoshoot, there are many unique studios and outdoor spots in Singapore that would go well with many couples. The outdoors provides a beautiful natural backdrop that does well in photoshoots, while a studio provides a safe environment with multiple sets and professional lights, ensuring a fixed environment that is not affected by weather and time. The talented photographers can capture the lovely moments shared between you and your partner, as they guide you on your best poses. With the photographer’s advice, you need not worry about how you will look in the pictures, and instead focus on enjoying the photoshoot. Hiring a wedding photographer to shoot on the actual wedding day allows the couple the opportunity to look back at the momentous day, especially the casual and genuine reactions their guests gave. The photographer is there to capture every moment, from the bride entering the venue to the couple interacting with their guests.

Our vendors are incredibly talented and can provide a range of outstanding services for your wedding photography needs. To see the photography style each studio is best in, refer to their respective websites and peruse through their portfolio. Some photography studios may be known for capturing grand and extraordinary pictures, while others may be regarded for their black-and-white photography. Couples can easily discover within their budget, a studio offering the best wedding photography package. The package will often include post-edits which the editing of pictures will be done by the photographer so that you can share some of your favourite pictures. The wedding package that has been agreed on will determine the set amount of pictures included. However, additional pictures can usually be added at an extra cost. Many of our vendors are highly regarded in the industry, and will always be willing to consider your requests.

You can either approach any of the studios or refer to our guides for extra information pertaining to some of the best wedding photography packages in Singapore. With the resources on Blissful Brides, you can find the best photography packages that will fulfill your criteria.

# Wedding Planner and Why Do You Need Them?

 2024-10-06

![Image 5: Wedding Planner and Why Do You Need Them?](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/public/assets/images/web-article/image/20241010/20241010160902_68362.jpg)

_Source:_ _[Pexels](https://www.pexels.com/vi-vn/anh/ng-i-dan-ong-m-c-ao-tr-ng-phia-tr-c-ng-i-ph-n-m-c-ao-dai-tay-mau-xanh-1181715/)_

Wedding planners handle all the details and keep track of everything you might not think of, ensuring your wedding runs smoothly and stress-free. Join Blissful Brides Vietnam as we explore the benefits of hiring a wedding expert.

Most wedding planners offer various levels of involvement in your planning process:

**Day-of Coordination:** Perfect for couples who have done most of the planning but need someone to execute their vision on the big day..

**Partial Planning:** If you need help with specific aspects of your wedding planning or have started but need someone to finish, this is the option for you.

**Full Service Planning:** For couples who want complete support from start to finish, full-service planning is the way to go.

![Image 6: Wedding Planner and Why Do You Need Them?](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/public/assets/images/web-article/image/20241010/20241010160942_96826.jpg)
_Source:_ _[Unsplash](https://unsplash.com/photos/mr-and-mrs-signage-gnm2op0m2pw)_

### 1.Saving time for the couple

One of the primary reasons couples hire wedding planners is to save time and effort throughout the planning process and on the wedding day itself. On average, planning a wedding can take over 200 hours or more.

From selecting venues to managing and coordinating vendors, professional wedding planners handle all the heavy lifting, allowing you and your partner to focus on other things—like enjoying that post-engagement glow!

Even if it's just six months or even seven days before your wedding, hiring a wedding planner is worth it when you consider the time you'll save.

Wedding planners are often industry insiders with years of experience working with vendors. This means they know the industry and exactly what needs to be done at each stage of the planning process.

### 2.Managing budgets and negotiating costs

With a wedding planner on your side, you can rest assured that your money will be spent wisely to bring your vision to life.

Wedding planners often have a pre-established network of preferred vendors. This not only helps them select the best vendors for your big day but can also lead to discounted rates.

Without a wedding planner, you'll have to do all the legwork yourself and may end up choosing subpar vendors, leading to budget overruns.

 Of course, you'll need to factor in the cost of hiring a wedding planner, so it's important to be upfront about this expense in your wedding budget. 
![Image 7: Wedding Planner and Why Do You Need Them?](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/public/assets/images/web-article/image/20241010/20241010161048_65143.jpg)

_Source:_ _[Pexels](https://www.pexels.com/vi-vn/anh/ng-i-l-p-k-ho-ch-va-gi-y-t-811572/)_

### 3.Becoming your trusted advisor

A skilled wedding planner is well-versed in the wedding industry. They know exactly which venues align with your wedding size, budget, and desired atmosphere. They also have a knack for matching couples with the perfect decor styles and vendors to ensure a seamless event.

Wedding planning can often cause stress between couples and their families. Wedding planners are skilled at mediating these situations and acting as a neutral third party to avoid conflict, find common ground, and provide optimal solutions.

### 4.Ensuring nothing is overlooked

When planning a wedding, wedding planners anticipate potential challenges and offer solutions. They handle all the small details that others might miss, such as creating contingency plans, developing a detailed timeline, and ensuring you have everything you need on your big day, down to the last bobby pin.

With so many things to consider, it's a relief to have a wedding planner who remembers everything.

### 5.Acting as your direct contact and up-to-date event updates

A wedding planner will be your primary contact with all vendors on your big day, allowing you to relax and enjoy your special day.

Wedding planners pay attention to the small details that could go wrong and ensure everything is handled promptly, from flowers arriving late to dealing with last-minute weather changes.

![Image 8: Wedding Planner and Why Do You Need Them?](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/public/assets/images/web-article/image/20241010/20241010161156_49099.jpg)

_Source:_ _[Pexels](https://www.pexels.com/vi-vn/anh/c-t-cac-b-n-gai-da-d-ng-vi-t-trong-sach-bai-t-p-5537545/)_

They handle everything smoothly and keep the event running seamlessly, so you don't have to worry about a thing. Unexpected incidents can happen at any time, but with a wedding planner, you'll have a team to handle it effectively.

When it comes to your big day, hiring a wedding planning team is a great idea as they can help bring your vision to life, avoid costly mistakes, and ensure everything is taken care of.

# 5 Tips To Create Photo Opportunities For Your Guests at Your Wedding

 2020-03-24

![Image 5: 5 Tips To Create Photo Opportunities For Your Guests at Your Wedding](https://bit.ly/public/assets/images/web-article/image/20200326/20200326115538_23605.jpg)

Everybody wants to share their beautiful moments to the world and [social media](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/articles/wedding/4-creative-ways-to-break-that-engagement-news-on-social-media "4 Creative Ways To Break That Engagement News On Social Media")has always been a great platform to do so. However, it’s not just the newlyweds who want to do so, but your guests too!

Help your guests out by giving them something to capture — taking #insta-worthy images can be challenging if you don’t get your wedding decor right from the very start. These 5 simple ideas will not only leave your guests in awe, but they will help you to capture those breathtaking moments.

### 1. Opt for wedding locations with ample light

![Image 6: 5 Tips To Create Photo Opportunities For Your Guests at Your Wedding](https://bit.ly/public/assets/images/web-article/image/20200326/20200326115631_21819.jpg)

_Source: Jeremy Wong Weddings on Unsplash_

The basis of a good photo is to have ample exposure, which translates into the need for good lighting. Whether you’ve opted for an indoor or [outdoor wedding venue](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/merchant/18/wedding-venues "Singapore Outdoor Wedding, Singapore Outdoor Wedding Venues"), ensure that enough natural lights seep in. After all, nobody likes watching backlit figures announce their vows.

### 2. Pick out the right colour palette

As with many visual aesthetics, colour plays an important role. Colours set the foundation for the mood and atmosphere you wish to have during the ceremony. Good colours also translate to great photos, so be sure to discuss with your [wedding planner](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/merchant/21/wedding-planners-decorator "Wedding Planner, Wedding Planner Singapore")what colour combination best suits your wedding theme and make your photos pop!

### 3. Flower décor

![Image 7: 5 Tips To Create Photo Opportunities For Your Guests at Your Wedding](https://bit.ly/public/assets/images/web-article/image/20200326/20200326115831_30937.jpg)

_Source: Annie Spratt on Unsplash_

Wedding décor is a miss and hit, especially if you have a theme to follow. However, not only are flower décor suitable for most, if not all, themes, they are also easy to work with! You don’t need to decorate the entire [wedding location](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/merchant/18/wedding-venues "Wedding Locations, Wedding Locations Singapore")with flowers, either. Sometimes, simplicity is best, and you can place them in selected areas such as the stage and reception tables instead.

Furthermore, you don’t necessarily need to use fresh flowers either. You can opt for paper flowers, which will also do the job. Not to mention, they are considerably more affordable than your fresh flowers.

### 4. Unique table settings

![Image 8: 5 Tips To Create Photo Opportunities For Your Guests at Your Wedding](https://bit.ly/public/assets/images/web-article/image/20200326/20200326115930_30938.jpg)

_Source: Photos by Lanty on Unsplash_

You can create several focal points for photo opportunities, with one being a unique table setting. Place a calligraphed menu, some pressed flowers, or even a prettily-wrapped wedding favour and you’ve got a #flatlay set-up all ready! Pretty and ornate tableware that your guests can gush over can also do the trick. Make an impression before the dishes are rolled out!

### 5. Focal point

![Image 9: 5 Tips To Create Photo Opportunities For Your Guests at Your Wedding](https://bit.ly/public/assets/images/web-article/image/20200326/20200326120022_47839.jpg)

_Source: Samantha Gades on Unsplash_

On that note, you may want to consider creating just one big focal point to beautify the entire venue, rather than overcrowding the place with decorations everywhere. Most couples will go for a beautiful wedding arch that can also help to frame the exchanging of your wedding vows, or decorating the top of your marquee with pompoms and paper flowers.

### Don’t forget the #hashtag!

Don’t forget your hashtags! Not only will they brand the day as your own, but it’s easier to track the photos on your social media as well. Encourage your guests to tag their photos with the hashtag and you never know, you might find a beautiful, candid moment captured.

# First Things First: Conversations Every Couple Should Have Before Wedding Planning

 2026-01-24

![Image 5: First Things First: Conversations Every Couple Should Have Before Wedding Planning](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/public/assets/images/web-article/image/20260305/20260305102342_91078.jpg)

_Source\_: [@‌\_jiu\_\_planner](https://www.instagram.com/jiu\_\_planner/)_

Before you start browsing venues or pinning décor ideas, there are crucial conversations that deserve your attention. These discussions set the foundation for not just your wedding day, but your marriage itself. Skipping them might mean discovering fundamental disagreements when you're already stressed about seating charts and vendor payments.

### Your Vision and Values

Start here: What does marriage mean to each of you? This isn't about romance. It's about understanding whether you view marriage similarly. Are you both equally committed? Do you see this as a lifelong partnership, or are there unspoken reservations?

Discuss what kind of wedding actually reflects who you are as a couple. Is a traditional hotel banquet important to you, or would you prefer an intimate garden ceremony? There's no right answer, but you need alignment. If one of you dreams of a lavish 300-person celebration whilst the other wants twenty close friends at a beach, you've got fundamental planning to do before booking anything.

Talk about the purpose of your wedding. Is it primarily to honour family and traditions? To celebrate with your community? To make a public commitment? Understanding your shared 'why' helps when making difficult decisions later.

### Money Matters

Financial conversations are uncomfortable but essential. Before discussing wedding budgets, you need clarity on your overall financial picture. What are your individual debts, savings, and financial goals? How do you each approach money? Are you a saver or a spender?

Discuss your wedding budget honestly. How much can you realistically afford without going into debt or depleting savings meant for other goals? Will family be contributing, and if so, does that money come with strings attached?

Be specific about who's paying for what. In Singapore, it's common for both families to contribute, but expectations vary. Some families expect to fund specific elements like photography or the bridal gown, whilst others provide a lump sum. Clarify this early to avoid awkward assumptions or last-minute surprises.

Also discuss: What happens if you go over budget? Where's your line, the amount beyond which you'll cut elements rather than spend more? What wedding elements are worth splurging on versus where you're comfortable saving?

Beyond the wedding itself, talk about your financial approach as a married couple. Will you merge finances, keep them separate, or adopt a hybrid approach? What are your short-term and long-term financial goals? These conversations matter far more than your centrepiece choices.

### Family Dynamics and Expectations

![Image 6: First Things First: Conversations Every Couple Should Have Before Wedding Planning](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/public/assets/images/web-article/image/20260203/20260203121310_92606.jpg)

_Source: Pexels_

Family involvement can make or break your planning experience. Discuss each family's expectations openly. What traditions or cultural elements are non-negotiable to your parents? What compromises are you willing to make, and where do you need to establish boundaries?

If your families are from different cultural backgrounds, how will you honour both traditions? This might mean two tea ceremonies, fusion menu elements, or creative ways to incorporate multiple customs. Plan how you'll navigate these waters together.

Talk about the decision-making process. Will you consult family on major choices, or make decisions independently? How will you handle unsolicited opinions or criticism? It's crucial to present a united front. Family members will inevitably have preferences, and you need to know you're approaching these conversations as a team.

Discuss guest list expectations early. If your mother expects to invite fifty relatives you've never met, or your father's business associates must be included, these conversations need to happen before you've signed a venue contract with limited capacity.

### Roles and Responsibilities

Wedding planning often defaults to one partner (typically the bride) whilst the other remains peripherally involved. This breeds resentment. Discuss upfront how you'll divide responsibilities based on interest, availability, and strengths.

Perhaps one of you loves design and will handle invitations and décor, whilst the other enjoys logistics and manages vendor contracts. Maybe you'll tackle everything together, or perhaps you'll hire a planner to manage most details. Whatever you choose, make it explicit rather than assumed.

Also discuss your expectations for involvement. If one partner is planning most elements, what level of input does the other want? Some people are happy to be surprised, whilst others want approval on every decision. Mismatched expectations here cause unnecessary conflict.

### Children and Future Planning

Your wedding naturally leads to conversations about your future together. Do you both want children? If so, how many, and what's your ideal timeline? What if you struggle with fertility? What options would you consider?

If one or both of you already have children, how will they be involved in the wedding? What role will they play in your married life together? These aren't simple conversations, but they're essential before legally and publicly committing to each other.

Discuss career aspirations and how they might affect family planning. If one of you is considering a major career change, starting a business, or pursuing further education, how does that impact your timeline for other life milestones?

### Lifestyle and Daily Life

Talk about where you'll live after marriage. If you're currently in separate homes, whose place will you move to, or will you find somewhere new? What neighbourhood matters to you, and what's your budget?

Discuss household responsibilities. Who cooks, cleans, manages bills, handles household admin? In dual-income Singapore households, equitable division of labour matters. Don't assume traditional gender roles or that things will 'just work out'.

Talk about your social lives. How much time do you expect to spend together versus with friends or pursuing individual hobbies? What does 'quality time' mean to each of you? Some people need daily deep conversation, whilst others are content with companionable silence.

### Health and Intimacy

Discuss your expectations around physical and emotional intimacy. What does a healthy intimate relationship look like to each of you? How do you prefer to handle conflicts? Do you need space, or do you want to talk immediately?

Talk about health habits and lifestyle. Are you both committed to certain wellness practices? How do you handle stress? What health conditions or mental health considerations should you both be aware of?

These conversations might feel awkward, but they establish foundations for navigating challenges together. Better to discuss them now than discover fundamental incompatibilities after you're married.

### The Actual Day

![Image 7: First Things First: Conversations Every Couple Should Have Before Wedding Planning](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/public/assets/images/web-article/image/20260203/20260203121749_33508.jpg)

_Source: thesynchronal_

Finally, discuss your wedding day itself. What moments matter most to each of you? What would make the day feel successful versus disappointing?

Talk about stress management. How will you support each other if things don't go perfectly? What's your backup plan for common issues like bad weather or vendor problems?

Discuss expectations for the days surrounding your wedding. Do you want a rehearsal dinner? What about post-wedding brunches? Who's responsible for coordinating these additional events?

These conversations aren't one-and-done. Keep talking throughout your engagement and beyond. The goal isn't perfect agreement on everything. It's understanding each other deeply enough to navigate disagreements with respect and love.

Your wedding celebrates your commitment, but these conversations build the actual foundation for your marriage.

Once you've had these important conversations, you'll be ready to start planning! Join us for Everlasting Love Wedding Showcase happening on Saturday, 11 April 2026, from 12pm to 7pm at Holiday Inn Express & Suites Singapore Novena.

Envision your ideal wedding celebration and let our team help turn your dreams into reality.

Along the way, discover thoughtful touches including welcome gifts, a curated tasting experience, and opportunities to enjoy exclusive offers and perks to make planning your day even easier.

Make your furry companion a part of the celebration and bring them along to march down the aisle with you. We offer a range of pet-friendly inclusions for a seamless experience.

In addition, host your wedding between 13 August – 12 September 2026 and enjoy a special booking benefit of one complimentary table with a minimum of 10 tables signed.

Couples who confirm their wedding package during the showcase will enjoy exclusive event-day perks, such as:

*    Complimentary one-night stay in our Studio Suite 
*    Complimentary one-night stay in our Standard Room 
*    Complimentary assorted canapés for your pre-event cocktail reception 
*    Complimentary mocktails for your pre-event cocktail reception 
*    Complimentary house wines 
*    IHG One Rewards member points 

At Everlasting Love Wedding Showcase, we invite you to bring your wedding dream to life and begin your happily ever after.

**_One location. Every detail. Simple, smart weddings._**

# The Truth Behind Weddings: 4 Wedding Planning Myths Debunked

 2021-06-30

![Image 5: The Truth Behind Weddings: 4 Wedding Planning Myths Debunked](https://bit.ly/public/assets/images/web-article/image/20210630/20210630135134_45578.jpg)

Weddings are truly extraordinary and unforgettable, once-in-a-lifetime affairs. As the ultimate celebration of the love and union between a couple, a wedding marks one of the most significant milestones they will ever have!

These beautiful ceremonies represent the beginning of a brand new future — not just for the bride and groom but also for their loved ones. However, aside from all the proposal highs and blissful moments, getting hitched often comes with a host of unrealistic expectations.

Thanks to those picture-perfect, [magical wedding moments](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/articles/wedding/3-must-watch-romantic-comedies-for-your-wedding-inspiration "3 Must-Watch Romantic Comedies For Your Wedding Inspiration") seen in movies and television shows, it’s natural to yearn for that same perfection on your special day. From the tear-jerking proposal to the romantic honeymoon, these unrealistic scenes depicted on on-screen romances have greatly influenced the notion of a wedding. In addition, wedding myths passed down from age-old cultural beliefs and stories have also been ingrained in our minds.

These myths have become tidbits of wedding wisdom that shaped how couples plan their wedding journey. But are there truths behind these misconceptions? To set the record straight, we will be debunking the following **four wedding myths**and help you discern between fact and fiction.

### 1. You Typically Need to be Engaged for At Least a Year

![Image 6: The Truth Behind Weddings: 4 Wedding Planning Myths Debunked](https://bit.ly/public/assets/images/web-article/image/20210630/20210630135608_94438.jpg)

_Source: Samantha Gades on Unsplash_

To plan a successful wedding ceremony and then enter a blissful marriage, traditional families believe that couples need to be engaged for _at least a year_.

According to wedding lore, an engagement period of at least a year gives couples ample time to re-evaluate their relationship, identify any red flags, and truly decide if their partner is their forever person — the one they want to spend the rest of their life with.

A year is also quoted as the average timeframe couples will take to plan out the nitty-gritty details of their wedding before getting hitched. But when it comes to marriage, **there is no magic number you need to follow.**

Some couples choose to get married immediately after putting a ring on it, while some remain engaged for a few years before sealing the deal.It’s all up to each couple’s own time.

### 2. It’s Time to Go All Out and Splurge on Your Wedding

![Image 7: The Truth Behind Weddings: 4 Wedding Planning Myths Debunked](https://bit.ly/public/assets/images/web-article/image/20210630/20210630135711_75253.jpg)
Funding the wedding of your dreams can be a hefty investment, but that does not mean you should kickstart your marriage life steeped in debt.

As much as you want to host an extravagant wedding and make your ceremony extra memorable, it is essential to make sensible financial decisions. Your pre-wedding photoshoots, [engagement rings](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/jewellery "Engagement Rings Singapore, Diamond Engagement Rings Singapore"), and[wedding catering](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/merchant/4/caterers "Wedding Catering Singapore")are all costly factors you must consider.

Going out of your budget and taking massive loans are **not feasible** in the long run, as you still have monthly bills and personal expenses to pay. Do not feel pressured to throw lavish weddings simply because you’ve seen many celebrities, influencers or even friends do it!

You do not have to spend a bomb on your wedding for it to encapsulate your eternal love for your partner. It’s best to set your priorities straight and only pay for what you can afford.At best, maybe your family members can chip in to share the cost with you, but only if they’re comfortable with that idea or willingly offer!

### 3. Walking Down the Aisle in a White Gown is Outdated

![Image 8: The Truth Behind Weddings: 4 Wedding Planning Myths Debunked](https://bit.ly/public/assets/images/web-article/image/20210630/20210630135855_71769.jpg)

_Traditional white gowns are beautiful, but not a must. You can be bold with your gown choices!_

A white dress might seem synonymous with weddings, but if you don’t feel your best wearing one, you _don’t_ have to don one while walking down the aisle.

In fact, recent bridal fashion shows have featured an elegant array of wedding gowns spotting new colours like pastels, blues, and even black. Check out [this article](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/articles/wedding/5-editor-s-choice-award-bridal-boutiques-for-gowns-hair-makeup-you-can-trust-in-sg) for a few recommendations on bridal boutiques to consider!

Though it has been rooted in tradition to wear white [wedding gowns](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/gowns-dresses "Wedding Gown Singapore, Wedding Gown Rental Singapore"), times have changed, and no matter what you choose to wear, your wedding attire should make you feel the most comfortable and beautiful.

If the outfit complements your overall ceremonial theme and makes you feel confident, then that’s probably the perfect dress for your special occasion.

### 4. Hiring a Wedding Planner is an Expensive Affair

![Image 9: The Truth Behind Weddings: 4 Wedding Planning Myths Debunked](https://bit.ly/public/assets/images/web-article/image/20210630/20210630140108_49644.jpg)

Contrary to popular belief, wedding planners do _not_ cost a fortune.

While employing wedding planners is indeed an added cost, but they can save you a lot of effort, stress, and money — putting a halt to any wedding woes in the long run. This is because they come with a **vast network of vendors and resources.**From sourcing for affordable bridal shops to the[best wedding photographers in Singapore](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/merchant/14/wedding-photography "Best Wedding Photographer Singapore, Wedding Photographer Singapore"), these experienced consultants are the ones who can bring your dream wedding to life.

Ultimately, [wedding planners](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/merchant/21/wedding-planners-decorator "Wedding Planner, Wedding Planner SIngapore")are professionals who can find the best possible deals and packages to fulfil your every need and desire. Let’s face it: planning a wedding is a huge responsibility, and organising everything yourself is a tall order for two individuals alone!

# Leave Your Worries at the Door with Andie Ng, Wedding Emcee 

 2023-01-10

![Image 5: Leave Your Worries at the Door with Andie Ng, Wedding Emcee ](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/public/assets/images/web-article/image/20230110/20230110141428_39771.jpg)

What does the perfect wedding emcee do?

A wedding emcee is the host of the festivities—their job is to keep everything running smoothly, keep your guests and loved ones entertained and ensure you and your partner are the stars of the show!

With that being said, one need not look further for the perfect emcee than Andie Ng: wedding emcee and host maestro!

### About Andie

![Image 6: Leave Your Worries at the Door with Andie Ng, Wedding Emcee ](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/public/assets/images/web-article/image/20230110/20230110141512_10877.jpg)

Energetic, passionate and friendly, Andie puts a personal and meaningful touch to the events she hosts for her clients. She’s a total people person—her bubbly personality makes it a breeze to interact with your guests and keep everyone comfortable and well-entertained.

She also majored in Chinese in University, and may even mix in Hokkein dialect to keep your guests laughing if you so wish.

# Blissful Brides’ Guest List Tool: An Easy & Efficient Way to Organise RSVPs

 2020-05-29

![Image 5: Blissful Brides’ Guest List Tool: An Easy & Efficient Way to Organise RSVPs](https://bit.ly/public/assets/images/web-article/image/20200528/20200528152321_47234.jpg)

_Source: picjumbo.com on Pexels_

Planning your [guest list](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/articles/wedding/how-to-decide-the-guestlist-for-your-wedding "How To Decide The Guestlist For Your Wedding?") early is important as it allows you to kickstart your wedding planning. Only with a good gauge of the number of people who are going to attend your wedding can you start to seriously hunt for suitable [wedding venues](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/merchant/18/wedding-venues "Wedding Venues Singapore, Small Wedding Venues Singapore"), but we know how troublesome and confusing it can be to keep track of your wedding guests - especially if you both have large extended families.

To help you stay organised, we’ve developed an **online wedding guest list tool** that’s dedicated to keeping track of your guest list with ease. Besides listing down details of each guest so that you and your future spouse know who’s who, you can also monitor RSVPs and make table arrangements for the wedding venue!

Here’s how you can get started!

### Step 1: Sign up as a member

![Image 6: Blissful Brides’ Guest List Tool: An Easy & Efficient Way to Organise RSVPs](https://bit.ly/public/assets/images/web-article/image/20200528/20200528152855_32386.jpg)

First and foremost, you would need to sign up as a member to get complimentary access to our various wedding planning tools, which includes the online guest list function. Membership is free-of-charge and only requires your email. After signing in, click on the [“Wedding Tools” tab](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/wedding-tools) and scroll down to #4, “Guest List”.

![Image 7: Blissful Brides’ Guest List Tool: An Easy & Efficient Way to Organise RSVPs](https://bit.ly/public/assets/images/web-article/image/20200528/20200528152944_50456.jpg)

### Step 2: Add your guests

![Image 8: Blissful Brides’ Guest List Tool: An Easy & Efficient Way to Organise RSVPs](https://bit.ly/public/assets/images/web-article/image/20200528/20200528153009_32422.jpg)

Once you’ve entered the Guest List function, the first thing to do would be to fill in the details of each guest. Start off by selecting which side does the guest belong to, before reaching the above page where you can fill in particulars such as their name and contact number. You may also include other important specifics such as plus ones or additional family members that they might be bringing along to the wedding, as well as specific events they are attending (i.e. just the solemnisation, just the banquet, or both the reception and banquet etc).

This helps you to stay organised as it consolidates guests from both sides all in one platform, as opposed to having two separate lists which may be more confusing and troublesome.

![Image 9: Blissful Brides’ Guest List Tool: An Easy & Efficient Way to Organise RSVPs](https://bit.ly/public/assets/images/web-article/image/20200528/20200528153200_26626.jpg)

Besides the 3 standard relationship categories (Yourself, Father, and Mother) that we have provided, you can also choose to customise more specific options such as “Secondary school friends” or “University friends”. This may be especially useful for those with a long guest list that comprises of various group of friends, as classifying different groups of people allows you to have a clearer picture of who’s attending your wedding and how the seating allocation should be like.

### Step 3: Finalising your list

![Image 10: Blissful Brides’ Guest List Tool: An Easy & Efficient Way to Organise RSVPs](https://bit.ly/public/assets/images/web-article/image/20200528/20200528153228_18664.jpg)

Since your guest list was first created based on a rough idea of who you’d like to invite, there are likely to be changes to make to your guest list leading up to the wedding date. Our wedding tool allows you to do just that easily - all you have to do is to click on the edit button represented by a pencil!

This includes indicating their presence after they have RSVP, or changing to “Not Attending” if they are not able to make it.

Moreover, the colour code function helps you to track down those who have yet to confirm their attendance at your wedding and the status of those who have (i.e. have they been allocated a seat yet?). Alongside the tally of the total number of guests at the bottom of your list, you can keep track of the confirmed number of wedding guests to ensure that it meets the requirements of your wedding venue.

![Image 11: Blissful Brides’ Guest List Tool: An Easy & Efficient Way to Organise RSVPs](https://bit.ly/public/assets/images/web-article/image/20200528/20200528153255_97647.jpg)

Even if you already have your guests consolidated on an excel sheet, you can still make use of our guest list tool to conveniently stay on top of each guest’s status! Simply download your excel sheet and import your guest list via the “Import from Excel” button.

### Stay organised and efficient

With these 3 easy steps, you can definitely create your very own online guest list with little hassle! Be sure to also check out our seating plan [function](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/member-login) too, which can sync with our guest list function to ease you through the process of visualising and planning your guests’ seat placements!

### Our Services

A love for celebration and warm hospitality are hallmarks of the Peranakans. At Village Hotel Katong, you can be sure your wedding will be lively and festive. Be it a themed wedding or an intimate banquet, our wedding team will see to it that your special day will be a most special one.

Situated in the conserved Katong precinct, Village Hotel Katong imbibes the district’s strong cultural heritage, clearly exhibited in the hotel’s design touches and nuances. Backed by our Peranakan fusion restaurant Nyonyas & Gentlemen, Village Hotel Katong serves a variety of cuisines, including Local Chinese, Asian, and Western, to delight your guests.

Village Hotel Katong is pleased to announce the attainment of the Singapore Halal Certification by Majlis Ugama Islam Singapura (MUIS), for our banquet kitchen's food preparation.

Save the date and discover a timeless celebration of love at Four Seasons Hotel Singapore’s exclusive open house and wedding showcase ‘Seasons of Love, Unveiled’ on Saturday and Sunday, 7 and 8 September 2024.

Featuring upcoming new ballroom venues that can accommodate up to 300 guests, elevated with world-class hospitality and award-winning culinary offerings, bask in a celebration of love and legacy in the heart of the city as you allow our wedding professionals to curate your personalised happily ever after with thoughtful details and inspiring creations.

Coupled with a collection of awe-inspiring indoor and outdoor rooftop spaces ideal for sky-high solemnisations or intimate parties, event highlights include various hands-on workshops, gourmet pass-around canapes, live entertainment, exclusive wedding perks, and more.

# Creating The Perfect Wedding Playlist: Do’s And Don’ts

 2024-07-29

![Image 5: Creating The Perfect Wedding Playlist: Do’s And Don’ts](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/public/assets/images/web-article/image/20240726/20240726101229_42919.jpg)

_Source:_ _[Pexels](https://www.pexels.com/photo/male-and-female-hands-on-piano-5156947/)_

[Creating the ultimate wedding playlist](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/articles/wedding/5-groovy-tips-to-create-the-ultimate-wedding-playlist "5 Groovy Tips to Create the Ultimate Wedding Playlist")can be both an exciting and daunting task. The soundtrack to your special day sets the tone and creates memorable moments that you and your guests will cherish for years to come. A well-curated playlist not only reflects your personal taste but also caters to the diverse musical preferences of your guests, ensuring everyone has a great time on the dance floor. Whether you're planning a grand celebration in a luxurious ballroom or a charming gathering in one of the many beautiful [outdoor wedding venues](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/merchant/18/wedding-venues "Outdoor Wedding Venues, Outdoor Wedding Venues Singapore"), your playlist is a crucial element in making your wedding day truly unforgettable.

Navigating the do's and don'ts of wedding playlist creation can be overwhelming, especially when balancing song choices, timing, and flow. A carefully crafted playlist considers the various segments of the day, from the ceremony and cocktail hour to dinner and dancing. It's essential to plan meticulously, ensuring each moment is perfectly complemented by the right music. This guide will provide you with practical tips and common pitfalls to avoid, helping you craft a flawless playlist that enhances the ambience of your celebration.

### Do’s

![Image 6: Creating The Perfect Wedding Playlist: Do’s And Don’ts](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/public/assets/images/web-article/image/20240726/20240726101357_27327.jpg)

_Source:_ _[Unsplash](https://unsplash.com/photos/black-dj-controller-on-table-F\_2bqTZ0Vl0)_

### 1. Start early

 Creating the perfect playlist takes time. Start planning your music as soon as you have a clear vision of your wedding theme and venue. This is especially important if you're holding your celebration at outdoor wedding venues, where the atmosphere plays a significant role in your song selection.

### 2. Consider your guests

 While your wedding is about you and your partner, it’s important to think about your guests. Include a mix of genres and eras to cater to various tastes and age groups. This ensures that everyone, from your college friends to your grandparents, enjoys the music. 
### 3. Hire a professional DJ or band

A professional DJ or band can make a significant difference. They have the experience to read the crowd and adjust the music accordingly. They also come with high-quality sound equipment, which is crucial, especially for outdoor wedding venues where acoustics can be challenging.

### 4. Balance the playlist

Ensure a good mix of upbeat and slower songs. Start with slower tunes during the cocktail hour and dinner, and then switch to more energetic tracks to get people on the dance floor. A balanced playlist keeps the energy levels right throughout the event.

### 5. Include your favourite songs

Incorporate songs that are meaningful to you and your partner. Whether it's your first dance, the song playing when you got engaged, or your favourite road trip anthem, these personal touches make your wedding uniquely yours.

### 6. Take song requests

Allowing guests to make song requests can be a fun way to engage them and ensure they hear songs they love. You can do this by including a song request line on your RSVP cards or having a request box at the reception.

### Don’ts

![Image 7: Creating The Perfect Wedding Playlist: Do’s And Don’ts](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/public/assets/images/web-article/image/20240726/20240726101716_71210.jpg)

_Source:_[_Unsplash_](https://unsplash.com/photos/woman-standing-with-boy-while-holding-white-signage-1IPCQ-cRD5k)

### 1.Don’t leave it to the last minute

Rushing your playlist can lead to missed details and poor song choices. Start early to ensure you have enough time to curate and refine your selections.

### 2. Avoid overly trendy songs

While it might be tempting to include the latest chart-toppers, consider how well these songs will age. Opt for timeless tracks that you’ll still love years down the road.

### 3. Don’t play inappropriate songs

Be mindful of your song lyrics and themes. Avoid songs with explicit content or those that could be offensive to guests of all ages.

### 4. Don’t forget the transitions

Smooth transitions between songs are crucial to maintaining the flow of the event. Abrupt changes in tempo or genre can disrupt the mood. If you're using a DJ, they will handle this, but if you're creating a playlist, ensure the songs transition well.

### 5. Don’t ignore the venue acoustics

Different venues have different acoustic qualities. For outdoor wedding venues, you’ll need to ensure that your sound system can project well and that your playlist is suited to the open environment. Test the sound system at your venue beforehand to make any necessary adjustments.

### 6. Don’t overlook the ceremony music

While much focus is on the reception, don’t forget the importance of music during your ceremony. From the prelude as guests arrive to the recessional as you walk back down the aisle, these moments are enhanced by the right musical backdrop.

### Make your wedding playlist unforgettable

![Image 8: Creating The Perfect Wedding Playlist: Do’s And Don’ts](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/public/assets/images/web-article/image/20240726/20240726102115_50127.jpg)

_Source:_ _[Unsplash](https://unsplash.com/photos/peach-yellow-and-white-flowers-o2zFDffQnDM)_

Crafting the perfect wedding playlist is an art that requires thoughtful consideration and planning. By following these do's and don'ts, you'll create a soundtrack that not only reflects your personal style but also enhances every moment of your special day. Remember to start early, consider your guests, and balance your selections to keep the energy just right. And if you're celebrating in one of the many beautiful outdoor wedding venues, make sure your sound system and song choices are perfectly suited to the setting.

# Morning Gatecrash: Should You Keep Or Skip The Tradition?

 2025-08-15

![Image 5: Morning Gatecrash: Should You Keep Or Skip The Tradition?](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/public/assets/images/web-article/image/20251007/20251007154204_36581.jpg)

The morning gatecrash is a well-loved and widely practised tradition among Chinese weddings in Singapore and Malaysia. It’s a playful and cheeky ritual that takes place before the official tea ceremony. The groom and his entourage (usually his groomsmen) are required to ‘win over’ the bride by completing a series of challenges set by the bridesmaids. These games range from hilarious to mildly torturous (think spicy wasabi-filled food or doing push-ups in suits), all in the name of fun and love.

Beyond the laughter and chaos, the gatecrash also symbolises the groom’s sincerity and willingness to go the extra mile to prove his love for the bride. Traditionally, it’s believed to ward off evil spirits and bring good fortune to the couple. While modern couples may not hold onto the same spiritual beliefs, many still choose to keep the tradition alive for its entertainment value and its potential to create memorable moments captured beautifully on camera.

### Reasons Couples Still Love the Morning Gatecrash

![Image 6: Morning Gatecrash: Should You Keep Or Skip The Tradition?](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/public/assets/images/web-article/image/20251007/20251007154237_23250.jpg)

One of the biggest reasons couples stick to this tradition is simple: it’s fun. There's nothing quite like kicking off the wedding day with laughter, camaraderie, and the slightly absurd sight of grown men singing love songs or dancing in tutus. For many, it's a moment that sets the tone for a joyful celebration. It also gives the bridal party a chance to bond and lets the couple look back on the day with fondness.

From a cultural standpoint, some families still place importance on this part of the wedding. Keeping the gatecrash can be a nod to tradition, honouring parents and grandparents who appreciate these symbolic gestures. It becomes more than just a game; it’s a family affair that bridges generations.

### When Gatecrash Might Not Be the Best Idea

![Image 7: Morning Gatecrash: Should You Keep Or Skip The Tradition?](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/public/assets/images/web-article/image/20251007/20251007154305_27140.jpg)

Despite all the joy it can bring, the gatecrash isn’t for everyone. Some couples prefer a calmer, more reflective start to their day, especially if the schedule is already packed with solemnisation, tea ceremonies, and receptions. If you’re dreaming of a [stress-free wedding morning routine](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/articles/trending/checklist-for-a-stress-free-wedding-morning-routine "Checklist For A Stress-Free Wedding Morning Routine"), gatecrash games might feel like an unnecessary complication.

There’s also the practical side to consider. Some grooms and groomsmen feel uncomfortable with public stunts or physically demanding challenges, especially in front of family members or photographers. Not every bridal party is game for chilli-filled pastries or cringe-worthy karaoke at 7 a.m.

Time constraints are another factor. Morning gatecrashes can eat up a surprising chunk of time. If your wedding schedule is tight, skipping the gatecrash could mean more breathing space to focus on other important moments.

### What To Do If You’re On The Fence

![Image 8: Morning Gatecrash: Should You Keep Or Skip The Tradition?](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/public/assets/images/web-article/image/20251007/20251007154454_14297.jpg)

Can’t decide whether to keep or skip it? You’re not alone. Many couples sit on the fence when it comes to this tradition. If you’re feeling torn, consider adapting the gatecrash to suit your personalities and preferences.

Some couples choose to tone down the games, opting for light-hearted trivia or challenges that focus more on heartfelt gestures rather than physical discomfort. Others set a time limit to keep things snappy and sweet. If you still want to honour the tradition without the fuss, you could even do a mock gatecrash the day before or incorporate elements into your photo shoot.

Another way to preserve the fun without the chaos is to speak to experienced [Singapore wedding vendors](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/ "Wedding Vendors Singapore") who can offer advice based on what they’ve seen work for other couples. Many [wedding planners](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/articles/wedding/top-your-wedding-checklist-with-the-wedding-planner "Wedding Planning Checklist, Wedding Planning Checklist Singapore") have creative solutions that help strike a balance between tradition and comfort.

### Capture The Fun Or Skip It Beautifully

![Image 9: Morning Gatecrash: Should You Keep Or Skip The Tradition?](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/public/assets/images/web-article/image/20251007/20251007154648_91856.jpg)

Let’s not forget one of the biggest perks of a gatecrash: the photos. These moments can be absolute gold for your wedding album: full of colour, laughter, and spontaneity. If you do go ahead with it, make sure it’s well documented. When [looking at wedding photography packages in Singapore](https://deals.blissfulbrides.sg/product/wedding-photoshoot-packages-jt-studio-sg/ "Wedding Photography Packages, Wedding Photography Packages Singapore"), check if the photographer has experience shooting gatecrash moments. A good one will know how to capture the chaos without getting in the way.

But skipping the gatecrash doesn’t mean you’ll lose out on memorable photos. A quiet morning can also be rich with beautiful, candid moments, like your mum helping you with your veil, your partner straightening their tie, or a quiet letter exchange between bride and groom. These gentle scenes also speak volumes and can be just as meaningful.

At the end of the day, your wedding should reflect you as a couple. Whether you decide to dive head-first into a full-blown gatecrash or skip it in favour of a peaceful morning, what matters most is that it feels right for you. Don’t feel pressured to follow every tradition just because it’s expected. Talk to each other, talk to your families, and find a compromise that brings joy rather than stress.

### Make Your Wedding Day Uniquely Yours

![Image 10: Morning Gatecrash: Should You Keep Or Skip The Tradition?](https://www.blissfulbrides.sg/public/assets/images/web-article/image/20251007/20251007154918_78587.jpg)

There’s no one-size-fits-all approach to weddings, and the same goes for the morning gatecrash. Embrace it if it sparks joy, adapt it to suit your needs, or skip it entirely without guilt. It’s your celebration, your story, and your choice.
